dedupe_keys.name: bayerischer denkmal atlas online bavarian monument list with wms

description: The Bayerischer Denkmal-Atlas is the online version of the Bavarian monument list, kept current by the Bavarian State Office for Monument Protection (BLfD) and open to everyone. Drawn over the official maps and aerial images of the Bavarian surveying administration, it shows listed buildings, archaeological monuments and ensembles across Bavaria, with archaeological sites mapped as areas at their known extent. Each object has a short description, and many listed buildings have photographs. The atlas is the public face of the office's specialist information system, which maintains the list and supports its role in planning procedures; the digital monument data are offered to district and municipal authorities and planning offices as a Web Map Service for their own GIS. Coverage: all of Bavaria. Access: map viewer and search in the BayernAtlas, monument lists as PDF per municipality, and a WMS. Licence: not stated on the pages read; free to view. Caveats: no vector download was found, so use in models means WMS layers or digitising from the lists. Simulation uses are heritage constraint and exposure layers for flood, heat and energy retrofit planning in Bavarian towns. Related records: the Germany official LoD2 building model and the US National Register spatial data.
